**Monday**, with tutoring after school from 3:00 to 5:00. It is a busy week: the Regions quiz on the Midwest is **Tuesday**, the Unit 5 math quiz is **Wednesday**, and the Lemonade Crime and vocabulary quizzes land sometime this week too.

Tomorrow comes first, so tonight is for the Midwest. Your history shelf has a Midwest part with all twelve states and their capitals. Say each capital out loud once, then try the quiz. Picture retakes are tomorrow as well.
